content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Introduction to Financial Functions focuses on the following parts of the supplied syllabus: Time value of money; Cash flows and discounting; Interest rates and payment periods; Financial-model assumptions. Keep the underlying source data visible and make each assumption explicit.
